description.zh: 目标端的类型，包括 OCEANBASE、KAFKA、ROCKETMQ、POLARDB_X_1、POLARDB_X_2 和 TIDB。
description.en: The type of the destination. Valid values are `OCEANBASE` for OceanBase, `KAFKA` for Kafka, `ROCKETMQ` for RocketMQ, `POLARDB_X_1` or `POLARDB_X_2` for PolarDB-X, and `TIDB` for TiDB.
The name of the worker instance.

description.zh: 是否仅查询可以绑定的实例，默认为 true。
description.en: Specifies whether to list only bindable instances. The default value is `true`.

description.zh: 页序号，分页查询时生效。
description.en: The page number to return for paginated queries.

description.zh: 页大小，分页查询时生效。
description.en: The number of entries to return per page for paginated queries.

description.zh: 源端的类型，包括 OCEANBASE、KAFKA、ROCKETMQ、POLARDB_X_1、TIDB 和 POLARDB_X_2。
description.en: The type of the source. Valid values are `OCEANBASE` for OceanBase, `KAFKA` for Kafka, `ROCKETMQ` for RocketMQ, `POLARDB_X_1` or `POLARDB_X_2` for PolarDB-X, and `TIDB` for TiDB.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro list-worker-instances --specs oms.g2m.small --instance-name i4katz0000 --source-type OCEANBASE --dest-type KAFKA --only-bindable true --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro ListWorkerInstances --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceName i4katz0000 --DestType KAFKA --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SourceType OCEANBASE --OnlyBindable true --Specs '["oms.g2m.small"]'
